## DIARRHEA WITH SHIGELLA (BACILLARY DYSENTERY) OR ENTEROINVASIVE E. COLI (EIEC)
Shigellosis is generally a self-limited infection lasting 5-7 days.
Antimicrobial resistance is common and continues to rise for all recommended
antimicrobials. Treatment should be reserved for patients who are
immunocompromised, or who develop severe illness.
## Primary treatment
Hydration and electrolyte replacement
## Antimicrobial treatment
## Inpatient [Ciprofloxacin 750 mg PO q24h for 3 days [R,DI]](psjzid-ciprofloxacin-750mg-po-q24h-for-3-days)
Alternative:
[Azithromycin 500 mg PO q24h for 3 days [M]](psjzid-azithromycin-500mg-po-q24h)
For patients who are hospitalized or unable to take oral medications:
[Ceftriaxone 2 gm IV q24h for 5 days [M]](psjizid-ceftriaxone-2gm-iv-q24h)
